categories.main_business_segments: Improve Medical Instruments Co., Ltd. primarily operates in medical devices and healthcare technology, focusing on vacuum blood collection systems, in vitro diagnostics (IVD) products including thromboelastography instruments, third-party specialized testing services mainly for oncology, and healthcare information technology solutions such as hospital information systems (HIS) and laboratory information management systems (LIS). The company also engages in manufacturing and sales of medical consumables and instruments, and provides integrated smart laboratory solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in blood specimen pre-analytical control, vacuum blood collection, and intelligent specimen management. It develops automated and intelligent diagnostic instruments like the fully automated thromboelastography analyzer with patented technology. Production follows strict quality management systems aligned with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and international regulatory standards including FDA, CE, and MDR/IVDR. Manufacturing employs batch production based on sales demand with flexible production lines and rigorous supplier evaluation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include tertiary hospitals, county-level and community hospitals, third-party medical testing laboratories, and healthcare institutions globally. The company serves clinical laboratories, oncology departments, and cardiovascular disease diagnostics sectors. Its products and services are used in over 100 countries, with significant presence in China’s major regions and expanding international markets including North America, Europe, and emerging markets in Asia, Africa, and Latin America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major sales concentrated in South China, East China, North China, Central China, and other regions. It also has a substantial overseas market presence accounting for nearly 30% of revenue, with operations and subsidiaries in the United States and other countries. The company maintains global distribution networks and participates in international medical device exhibitions and academic conferences to expand its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Improve Medical is positioned midstream in the medical device supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of medical consumables and diagnostic instruments. It integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream sales and service to hospitals and laboratories. The company also extends into downstream services by providing third-party specialized testing and healthcare IT solutions, forming a comprehensive medical service platform.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening its core vacuum blood collection business while expanding into molecular diagnostics and oncology companion diagnostics. It emphasizes innovation in specimen pre-analytical control, automation, and intelligent laboratory management. R&D priorities include developing high-value, long-lasting products, integrating AI into diagnostic instruments, and expanding IVD product lines. The company also pursues global regulatory certifications and collaborates with academic institutions to accelerate product development and clinical application.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of medical devices, consumables, and diagnostic reagents. Additional income streams include software licensing and services related to hospital information systems and laboratory management solutions, as well as third-party specialized testing services. The company also earns financing lease income and maintenance service fees, though these constitute a smaller portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Improve Medical is a leading domestic player in China’s vacuum blood collection market and holds a unique position as the only domestic vacuum blood collection tube manufacturer with FDA registration. It competes with multinational corporations in the IVD and medical device sectors but differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, regulatory compliance, and integrated solutions. The company is recognized as a technology leader and standard-setter in its field, with a growing presence in international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 581 million, a 9.82% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 118 million, reflecting challenges including asset impairments and fair value changes. Despite short-term profitability pressures, the company maintains positive operating cash flow and continues investing in R&D with a dedicated team of over 140 engineers. It has a solid asset base exceeding RMB 1.2 billion and is focused on strategic restructuring and cost optimization to improve future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Improve Medical emphasizes high-quality, innovative products with strong clinical validation and regulatory approvals, including unique patented technologies in blood specimen management and thromboelastography. Its integrated smart laboratory solutions and comprehensive service platform enhance diagnostic accuracy, patient experience, and operational efficiency for healthcare providers. The company’s commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement, combined with its academic collaborations and global certifications, differentiates it as a trusted partner in precision medicine and clinical diagnostics.
